_warning: OPUS-AUTHORED semantic GraphRAG of the `cloud` repo — NOT machine-derived. Regenerate by re-running the Opus signatures-level pass over dist/code-signatures-cloud.json. Complements (does not replace) the deterministic kg-graph delta (build-kg-graph_delta.json). This layer encodes INTENT/relationships (orchestrates, feeds, deploys, proxies, shields) that imports alone cannot.

_meta.altitude: signatures-level (read dist/code-signatures-cloud.json ~244k tokens, not full bodies ~5.6M)

node_tables_extra.desc: A cohesive architectural unit (engine group, pipeline stage, service cluster, protection layer).

properties.name: 2_configs build pipeline
properties.description: The single source of truth compiler. Scans every a_solutions/*/build.json + config.json + b_infra/*/build.json via typed parsers (build-json, compose, caddyfile, authelia, dns, wireguard, terraform), MERGES them into _cloud-data-consolidated.json (the master), then DERIVES per-consumer artifacts. SOLE emitter — every symlink in services/ resolves into 2_configs/dist/.

properties.name: cloud-data-config-consolidated
properties.description: Stage 1: merges all declared sources (build.json per service, config.json topology, vault wg pubkeys, home-manager) into _cloud-data-consolidated.json. WireGuard public keys come from vault/A0_keys/providers/wireguard/<name>/publickey (SoT) — config.json values are a stale fallback being phased out.

properties.name: cloud-data-config-derive (+ derivers.json)
properties.description: Stage 2: from the consolidated master, emits per-container build-*.json, Caddy routes (build-caddy.json), Authelia ACL, DNS, the kg-graph schema+delta, mesh-snapshot, build-workflows, external-consumers slices, and code-signatures. Ordered registry in derivers.json (data-driven; append a JSON entry to add one).

properties.name: 1_workflows ship engine
properties.description: Universal deploy engine. Per service: build (nix) → secrets (sops→dist/.secrets) → deploy (rsync) → compose (up -d --no-build). Builds run on a RUNNER (oci-apps ARM via build-workflows.json .runners, or GHA) and push GHCR images; VMs only pull. step pipeline: build-nix, build-docker, build-compose, secrets-decrypt, deploy-rsync, deploy-compose, deploy-health, lifecycle.

properties.name: home-manager ship engine
properties.description: Delivers per-VM home-manager as a GHCR Docker image (1GB VMs can't `nix eval` — they OOM): build flake → push image → VM pulls + activates. Carries vm-pilot (protection layers) onto every VM.

properties.name: vm-pilot system protection
properties.description: Per-VM resilience, delivered by home-manager. scheduler.nix puts SSH/WG in connectivity.slice (CPUWeight=10000, OOMScoreAdjust=-900) and caps docker.slice; resource-bouncer (earlyoom + docker MemoryMax); load-shedder.nix (NEW) stops ALL docker on memory PSI pressure to keep WG/SSH alive — VM sheds load instead of freezing; rescue-ssh (dropbear, WG-bound); no-build-guardrails HARD-BLOCKS docker build on <2GB VMs.

properties.name: cloud-cgc-mcp (Code Graph Context)
properties.description: MCP server, 3 layers: (A) a-knowledge — reads _cloud-data-consolidated.json for topology/configs/specs/skills; (B) octocode — FastEmbed semantic search + GraphRAG over /repos (volumes octocode_db/octocode_repos, GIT_ROOT=/repos); (C) codegraph — stubs for the kg-graph. config.ts reads the consolidated superset (not retired config.json).

properties.name: kg-graph (SurrealDB hybrid KG)
properties.description: SurrealDB graph+vector store. Schema + idempotent delta DERIVED from the consolidated master (vm/service/container/domain + repo/module/package nodes; hosted_on/proxied_by/belongs_to_repo/implements/declares_tool/consumes edges). enabled:false (planning). This semantic layer is its GraphRAG overlay.

properties.name: C3 API + MCP (infra/services)
properties.description: Control plane. c3-infra-api/mcp drives SSH/Docker/build/Dagu (DAGU_API base path data-driven from services.dagu.api.base_path = /api/v1). c3-services-api/mcp = consolidated service REST/MCP registry. shared/libs/ops.ts triggers DAGs + push events.

properties.name: health/security reports (Rust)
properties.description: Rust crates (tokio/reqwest/trust-dns): cloud-health-full-daily, cloud-mail-health-full, cloud-sec-data-report. Probe endpoints/DNS/TLS/WG/containers via reports_common; render md/html/mermaid/d2. Read-only collectors over the WG mesh.

properties.name: edge + auth (Caddy/Authelia/WG)
properties.description: Caddy is the single routing SoT: HTTP reverse_proxy + L4 SNI mux on :443 (incl. mail IMAPS/SMTPS), derived into build-caddy.json. Authelia = 2FA/OIDC; introspect-proxy validates bearer tokens. All inter-VM traffic over the WireGuard mesh (10.0.0.0/24); public edge = oci-analytics.

properties.name: dagu workflow scheduler
properties.description: DAG scheduler (moved oci-analytics→oci-apps to stop freezing the 1GB VM). Runs ops_octocode-reindex: clone repos (fresh git reset --hard) → octocode clear+index into octocode_db → restart cgc. API at /api/v1 (image is v1; the c3 tools' /api/v2 was the bug).

properties.name: a_solutions services (60+)
properties.description: Every service = build.sh (universal engine symlink) + build.json (config) + src/{flake.nix→compose.nix}. flake builds the docker-compose.yml from compose.nix + _shared/engine.nix; the port-enforcement lib auto-injects port env from build.json. Prefixes: aa-sui app, ab-mic mic, ac-fin fin, ad-agi agi, ba-clo cloud, bb-sec/bb-net sec/net, bc-obs tools, ca-dat data.

properties.name: _cloud-data-consolidated.json
properties.description: The master superset (vms, services, configs, dns, deps, wireguard). Single source of truth read by every consumer.

properties.name: build-caddy.json
properties.description: Aggregated Caddy routes (reverse_proxy + L4 SNI), consumed by bb-sec_caddy/src/caddyfile.nix.

properties.name: code-signatures-cloud.json
properties.description: Per-file exports/imports/symbols (~244k tokens) — input to this semantic pass + the kg-graph code nodes.

properties.name: octocode FastEmbed+GraphRAG index
properties.description: Per-repo LanceDB index keyed by /repos/<repo> path hash. Built by ops_octocode-reindex; queried by cgc octocode tools.

properties.name: build-workflows.json
properties.description: Runner-image registry: .runners[arch].host routes a build to oci-apps(arm64)/GHA(amd64). Enforces builds-on-runner doctrine.

properties.rationale: stage 2 runs every entry in derivers.json after consolidate
derive reads the master the consolidator wrote
arch-routing: build on oci-apps ARM / GHA, never on the small target VM
connectivity.slice keeps WG/SSH alive; load-shedder stops docker before a freeze drops the mesh
octocode search + graphrag tools shell `octocode` over /repos
codegraph tools target the kg-graph (this semantic overlay + the deterministic delta)

properties.via: Authelia 2FA/OIDC + introspect-proxy bearer; WG-only for mcp/private

properties.rationale: probes WG mesh + public URLs + Caddy/Authelia health
cgc is itself an a_solutions service (image-wrapper, ARM runner)
